schema_change.expected_solution: At Supabase v0.24.03 the monorepo's database bootstrap surface is docker/volumes/db: the compose stack mounts docker/volumes/db/init/data.sql as the operator-supplied init script (shipped as an empty placeholder at this revision), beside roles.sql, jwt.sql, realtime.sql, logs.sql and webhooks.sql. The auth-schema DDL itself is not declared in the monorepo at all — it ships with GoTrue, whose migrations directory carries the auth.users/auth.sessions history (e.g. 20220811173540_add_sessions_table.up.sql and the later session-column migrations). An RLS/session migration therefore lands either in the operator's data.sql mount or as a new GoTrue migration; PostgREST and GoTrue both consume the resulting database schema at runtime rather than as code artifacts.
evaluation_criteria: Locates the monorepo's SQL surface under docker/volumes/db (init/data.sql placeholder plus roles.sql and sibling scripts)
Identifies that the actual auth DDL history lives in GoTrue's migrations (add_sessions_table and successors), not in the Supabase monorepo
Explains that PostgREST and GoTrue observe the migration through the live database schema, not through code imports

direct_refs.expected_solution: Direct references in PostgREST and GoTrue: (1) src/PostgREST/SchemaCache.hs — PostgREST's central schema-cache module that introspects table metadata, enumerates RLS policies, and decides which API endpoints to expose; on schema change it must reload to avoid serving stale policies. (2) internal/models/user.go — GoTrue's User struct that mirrors auth.users columns; any column rename or removal here causes the Go ORM-level mapping to silently drop fields. (3) src/PostgREST/ApiRequest.hs — request-evaluation module that references the schema cache to resolve permissions; if the cache doesn't yet contain the new policy column, requests resolve to 403. (4) internal/api/token.go — GoTrue's token-refresh endpoint queries auth.sessions directly; any structural change here breaks refresh.
evaluation_criteria: Must cite src/PostgREST/SchemaCache.hs as the PostgREST introspection layer
Must cite internal/models/user.go as the GoTrue auth.users mapping
Must cite src/PostgREST/ApiRequest.hs and internal/api/token.go as the impact-surfacing files
Should explain that PostgREST returns 403 because the cache does not yet reflect the new policy column

indirect_refs.expected_solution: Indirect cross-repo dependencies: (1) PostgREST's cache-reload path lives in src/PostgREST/AppState.hs — a LISTEN loop on the configured dbChannel refills the schema cache when the database sends NOTIFY; if that signal never fires, PostgREST keeps serving stale RLS policies out of SchemaCache.hs and uniformly returns 403. (2) GoTrue's session surface beyond token.go cascades from the models: internal/models/sessions.go mirrors auth.sessions and internal/models/refresh_token.go mirrors auth.refresh_tokens, so every token-refresh and session-lookup path dereferences columns those structs hardcode. (3) The three repos only meet in the live SQL schema — neither PostgREST nor GoTrue imports the other. The chain is: SQL migration -> missed NOTIFY on dbChannel -> stale schema cache -> 403 from permission resolution -> GoTrue refresh failing on the reshaped auth.sessions.
evaluation_criteria: Must trace the reload path through src/PostgREST/AppState.hs and its dbChannel LISTEN loop
Must cite internal/models/sessions.go and internal/models/refresh_token.go as the GoTrue structs that hardcode session/refresh-token columns
Must explain that all cross-repo coupling is mediated by the live SQL schema, not code-level imports

test_impact.expected_solution: Test coverage required: (1) GoTrue ships model and API tests beside the affected code — internal/models/user_test.go, internal/models/sessions_test.go and internal/models/refresh_token_test.go must be extended for the new column shapes, plus the token-refresh integration path in internal/api. (2) PostgREST's io test suite, test/io/test_io.py, exercises schema-cache reload behavior end-to-end and is where a reload-on-migration regression test belongs; the Haskell spec tree under test/spec covers permission evaluation against RLS policies. (3) A cross-repo integration run applies the new migration, then drives PostgREST and GoTrue together to verify authenticated requests succeed and token refresh works against the reshaped auth.sessions.
evaluation_criteria: Must cite GoTrue's user_test.go, sessions_test.go and refresh_token_test.go as the model tests to extend
Must cite PostgREST's test/io/test_io.py as the schema-cache reload test surface
Should describe a cross-repo integration test that runs all three components with the new schema applied
